A member of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith]], a '''[[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]''' was one of many led by [[Darth Nihl]] at the [[Massacre at Ossus]] in [[130 ABY]], purging the [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Praxeum]] and scattering the [[New Jedi Order]]. Before the end of the battle, the Zabrak Sith was killed by [[Kol Skywalker]].
